_comment: Custom LithumMC egg for Pelican and Pterodactyl panels. Import through the panel administrator, choose a Java 21 image, then upload LithumMC.jar to the server root.
name: LithumMC
author: LithumMC contributors
description: LithumMC Minecraft server for Linux x86_64. Choose a Java 21 image and upload LithumMC.jar to the server root after installation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo 'LithumMC egg installed. Upload LithumMC.jar to the server root before starting.'
